snippet.description:
Defiance (1997) - PC Gameplay / Win 10

Subscribe here ►►► http://www.youtube.com/subscription_center?add_user=FirstPlaysHD
Also SHARE, COMMENT, LIKE ☺

Defiance is a 1997 video game for Microsoft Windows, developed by American studio Logicware and published by Visceral Productions of Avalon Hill. The game is a first-person shooter, with 

Defiance is a first-person shooter with primitive 3D graphics, playing very similarly to Doom (1993). The graphics of Defiance use the 2.5D style, a way to make 2D graphics look 3D. It also includes a dynamic aim feature, where the camera bobs based on movement input. The player controls an elite unnamed fighter pilot who rides the LAV-6 SABER, a weaponized mech, as they traverse through Calchona, a military complex. The first level of Defiance acts as a tutorial stage, introducing several of the game's core mechanics, such as the thruster, and setting up the plot. From that point on, the levels, which there are 13 of, play much like Descent (1995). In game, there are a plethora of enemies to fight. The player must also manage lift fuel, shields, hull durability, and weapons. Enemies often swarm the player through the complex, labyrinth like level setup of the game.


░▒▓ PC Hardware ▓▒░

CPU: Intel Core i7 8700K
RAM: 32 GB
GPU: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1080
OS:  Windows 10 64bit
